ページ「案件の 3つの 形を 確かめよう」の カード 3枚（SES・受託開発・自社開発）。

2026-09-03 に 作り直し。旧アプリの 講義スライドは 字が 絵に 焼き込まれて いて
「（例：タンバム）」が 直せなかった（タンバムは 自社開発の 主流では なく なった）。

**1回目の 作り直しは 失敗した。** 暖かい オフィスの 場面は 描けたが、
「どれが お客様で どれが 自分の 会社か」が 読めず、雰囲気だけの 絵に なった
（2026-09-03 の 指摘「ただのイラストではなく、説明するための画像」）。
この 台帳は **旧スライドの 説明の 骨を そのまま 残す** 2回目。

## 旧スライドの 骨（これを 保つ）
1. SES … 人が カバンを 持って、矢印で **お客様の 会社**へ 入って いく
2. 受託開発 … お客様が **依頼の 書類を 渡して いる**（受け渡しが 主役）
3. 自社開発 … **自分の モニターと スマホ**で、自分たちの アプリを 作って いる

## 絵に 字は 書けない（規律2・設計01 §4-10）ので、役割は 見た目で 描き分ける
3枚 ぜんぶで 同じ 約束を 通す。ここが 読めるかの すべて:
- **お客様** = 濃い 紺の フォーマルな スーツ＋ネクタイ。年上に 見える
- **自分の 会社の エンジニア** = 明るい カジュアル（水色シャツ／緑のフーディ）。ネクタイ なし
- **お客様の 会社** = 灰色と 青の ガラスばりの 高いビル。受付カウンターが ある
- **自分の 会社** = 暖かい レンガの スタジオ（受託開発と 自社開発で **同じ 部屋**）
- 場面は **1枚に 1つの 考え**だけ。人は 2〜3人まで。近くから 大きく 撮る

生成 PNG は cwebp -q 84 で webp に して dest へ 置く。
style: Style: warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, soft cel shading, bright natural daylight. This is a TEACHING picture, not a mood picture: the composition must be simple and diagrammatic so a beginner can read WHO is who and WHERE they are at a glance. Few elements, large and clear, close to the camera. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions and warm friendly faces.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image — not on buildings, signs, documents, badges, screens or walls. Papers and screens carry only simple drawings, coloured blocks and abstract shapes. No watermark, no signature, no logo.
negative: Never: readable letters or numbers of any script, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, infographic panels, minimalist clip-art, 3D render, photo realism, crowded busy scenes with many small figures, wide empty margins, dark or scary tone, angry or crying faces, extra fingers or limbs, robots, mascots, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders. The reference image is ONLY a drawing-style guide — never copy its objects or its people into the scene.

scenes.title: SES — 自分の 会社を 出て、お客様の 会社へ 入って 働く
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Simple diagrammatic composition, read left to right, subject large and close.
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: this engineer leaves his own company and goes to work INSIDE the customer's company building. Composition, read left to right: on the FAR LEFT edge, small and behind him, the doorway of a low WARM RED-BRICK studio he is walking away from. In the CENTRE, drawn LARGE and clearly, ONE Cambodian software engineer in his mid twenties — slim, short neat black hair, a bright LIGHT-BLUE casual shirt, NO tie — striding to the right, carrying a laptop shoulder bag in one hand, a blank white visitor card clipped to his chest. A BIG simple soft-grey arrow lies flat on the paving beneath him: its TAIL begins at the brick doorway on the LEFT and its ARROWHEAD IS AT THE RIGHT END, touching the glass entrance. THE ARROWHEAD MUST POINT RIGHT, toward the tower — never left, never back at the brick building. The whole picture reads left to right: own small office → walking → customer's tower. On the RIGHT, filling that half of the frame, the open glass entrance of a TALL GREY-AND-BLUE CORPORATE OFFICE TOWER: sliding glass doors, a wide reception counter, and just inside it TWO of that company's own staff in formal dark navy suits with ties turn and welcome him with a small bow and an open hand. He is clearly the outsider arriving into THEIR building. Draw hands carefully: exactly five fingers each, no tangled or merged fingers. Bright clear morning light.

scenes.title: 受託開発 — お客様が 依頼の 書類を 渡し、自分の 会社の 中で 作る
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Simple diagrammatic composition centred on the handover, subject large and close.
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: the customer hands over a request, and the work is then built here, inside the engineers' OWN office. The room is unmistakably a WARM RED-BRICK STUDIO with wooden desks and green plants — the same room as the in-house-development picture. THE CENTRE OF THE FRAME, large and unmissable, is THE HANDOVER: an older customer in a dark navy FORMAL SUIT WITH A TIE, standing on the left side of a wooden desk, holds out a thick WHITE PAPER DOCUMENT with both hands across the desk; a young engineer in a bright LIGHT-BLUE casual shirt, NO tie, seated on the right side of the desk, reaches up and takes it with both hands. Their four hands and the white document are the brightest, clearest thing in the picture. The paper carries only faint coloured blocks, never letters. BEHIND the seated engineer, smaller and slightly out of focus, TWO of his own colleagues in casual clothes work at monitors showing colourful abstract screen mockups, already building it. The customer stands on the visitor side of the desk and does not sit — this room belongs to the engineers. Draw hands carefully: exactly five fingers each, no tangled or merged fingers. Bright afternoon light.

scenes.title: 自社開発 — お客様は いない。自分の 会社で 自分たちの アプリを 作る
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. Simple diagrammatic composition, monitor and phone side by side, subject large and close.
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: there is NO customer here — these engineers are building their OWN app for themselves. Same WARM RED-BRICK STUDIO as the contract-development picture, so the learner sees it is the same company. Drawn LARGE and close: ONE young engineer in a green casual hoodie, NO tie, sits at a wooden desk facing a BIG DESKTOP MONITOR that fills the left half of the frame; the monitor shows the app being made — bold colourful rounded blocks and simple graph shapes, never letters. In his raised right hand, held up beside the monitor at the same height, is a SMARTPHONE showing THE SAME colourful app design, finished and running. A BIG simple soft-grey arrow curves from the monitor to the phone, so it reads as: we make it here, and it becomes this. Beside him ONE colleague in a light-blue casual shirt leans in and points at the phone with a pleased smile. ABSOLUTELY NO ONE IN A FORMAL SUIT, no tie, no visitor card, no document being handed over anywhere in the picture. Draw hands carefully: exactly five fingers each, no tangled or merged fingers. Soft warm late-afternoon light.
